title: Will there be at least 2 presidential actions in the week of Oct 18, 2026?
rules: If Donald Trump has taken at least 2 presidential actions from Oct 18, 2026 through Oct 24, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 25, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication dates visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 25, 2026.
The week runs from Oct 18, 2026 through Oct 24, 2026.

Payout criteria

The actions may include proclamations, executive orders, nominations & appointments, and memoranda.
Any item listed on the page counts, regardless of its legal effect.

Examples (for Jan 10, 2026):

Executive Order with a Jan 7 signing date is released with a Jan 10 publication date → resolves Yes
Proclamation e-mailed to White House Press Pool but not uploaded by 10:00 AM next day → resolves No
Proclamation is released Jan 10 with a backdated Jan 9 publication date → resolves No
Bill signed into law and shows up on "Briefings & Statements" instead of "Presidential Actions" → resolves No

blind.reasoning: The whitehouse.gov Presidential Actions page already lists one item in the window (the Oct 19 women's health executive order), so only one more with an Oct 20–24 publication date is needed. Items have recently appeared on about 6 of every 21 days, which gives roughly a 70–75% chance of at least one more posting in the remaining 4–5 days. The recent 9-day gap (Oct 8–15) and the busy midterm campaign schedule keep a real chance that nothing else is posted.
blind.falsifier: The whitehouse.gov Presidential Actions page on Oct 25 at 10 AM ET shows no item with a publication date from Oct 20 to Oct 24, 2026.

final.reasoning: The market at 0.825 likely reflects information I couldn't verify, such as possible postings after Oct 19, so I move up from 0.72 toward it. My remaining gap below the midpoint is small and doesn't justify buying NO.
